text_block_list.text:
One day, as Сайленс Судзука is finishing
up her
training...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for today. By the way, about

tomorrow's training session...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! Look, it's Suzuka! Let's nab this
cutie, eh,
Bourbon? ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Understood, Falcon. Now commencing
capture
procedure.
text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон

text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait a—Bourbon!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
In the blink of an eye, Сайленс Судзука is
swept
away by the two Umamusume. I
rush frantically
after them...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
One, two, smile! Pose! One, two, pose!
That's
it! ☆ All right, now, all
together! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
One, two, smile. Pose. One, two, pose.
All
commands executed successfully.
text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон

text_block_list.text:
Well... I've been invited to dance
lessons. I'm not
very good at saying no...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It's 'cause you and Bourbon are totes
Umadol
material!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Materials are irrelevant. These lessons
are
valuable.
text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон

text_block_list.text:
Falcon excels in emotional expression.
There is
much to be learned by
referencing her speech and
conduct.
text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон

text_block_list.text:
All right, let's give it our all! We've got a
fan
watching today! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming. The presence of a
third
party is important for improving our
performance.
text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон

text_block_list.text:
You're so right! Well then, let's start the
music!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I stick around a while and watch the
three
practice.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Next, let's rehearse some call and
response! I'll
give an example.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
All right, you over there! When I give
you the
signal, you scream out,
"FAAALCOOO!" Okay?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Oh... Now you're getting dragged into
this too...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Are you're reeeadyyy?! Fa-fa-fa...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It needs a little more oomph, like

"FAAALCOOO!" ☆ Okaaay, let's do
Bourbon
next!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Understood. Commencing operation.

Bour-Bour-Bour...
text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон

text_block_list.text: BOURBON!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Ah! Perfection! ♪ Just what I expected
from
Suzuka's trainer!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And now for the headliner! Aaah! I can't
wait! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Umm... What do I do?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Easier said than done...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: You never know if you don't try, Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
A good concert relies on the full effort
of both
the Umadols and their fans!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Um... Uh... I still don't... Maybe,
something like—
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: S-suzu-suzu-suzu...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
You were perfectly synchronized with
your fan.
This performance is a verified
success.
text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон

text_block_list.text:
Totally! You're really coming into your
own as an
Umadol, Suzuka!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
The three Umadols are bursting with
motivation. I
look forward to seeing
where they go from here!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
B-but what if nothing feels right? Um...
Uh...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: I-I'm Сайленс Судзука! ...Yaaay!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Um... I just did what seemed right...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: No...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
WAY! Suzuka! That was amazing! Like,
so cute! So
adorbs!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Really?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Intriguing. A display of shyness can
prove quite
effective. I will remember
this.
text_block_list.name: Михоно Бурбон

text_block_list.text:
I knew I was right about you, Suzuka!
You have
what it takes!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Um... You can stop us at any point...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
It seems Сайленс Судзука is making big
strides as
an Umadol! I think!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
